extracted text: The material under investigation was the aluminium alloy, 7017, of nominal composition (in weight %) 4.83 Zn, 2.19 Mg, 0.11 Cu, 0.29 Mn, 0.14 Zr, 0.17 Cr, 0.24 Fe, 0.11 Si, 0.04 Ti, balance Al. This is a weldable alloy, used as an armour material. It was supplied in the form of rolled plate, dimensions 150 mm × 150 mm × 75 mm. These were solution treated at 475 °C, followed by aging at 120 °C. Two aging regimes were chosen. The first was aged for 2 h to produce an under-aged condition (UA), whilst the second was aged for 24 h to produce an optimum balance of properties in the peak-aged (PA) condition.
